column1: # Allele definitions for the compound locus STTR3, from Table 4 of Larsson et al. 2009
# (Euro Surveill 14(15):19174), the ECDC nomenclature paper. STTR3 interleaves a 27 bp and a 33 bp
# repeat unit, so a single unit length cannot express it and the allele is a composite: the number
# of 27 bp units times 100 plus the number of 33 bp units, which is the allele number this table
# assigns. Only STTR3 is binned; the other four loci are called from their repeat unit as usual.
# The size is the fragment size that table pairs with each allele. The reference LT2 product is
# 490 bp, which is allele 211, two 27 bp units and eleven 33 bp units.
